integrity: The closed formulas are proved symbolically from the three exhaustive forms of an order-preserving self-map. Independent finite regression computes \(H_1\) ranks from edge-chain images rather than assuming the rank formula. Search non-detection is treated as residual risk, not as a proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to \(p,q\ge 3\); it does not classify multiplicities of individual \(H_1\) matrices. Finite enumeration checks only \((3,3)\) and \((3,4)\) and is not used as the infinite proof. Full text of Stong's 1966 foundational article was not directly accessible during this review.
title: Self-homotopy and homology-action classification of complete height-two finite graph models
